data.long_meaning: The name Linahtun is derived from the Arabic word 'lina' which means jasmine flower. It is a beautiful and fragrant name that evokes the image of a blooming flower. The name Linahtun carries the meaning “Jasmine flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Linahtun usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Linahtun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jasmine flower.”

in_arabic.long_meaning: ليناحتون هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني اللينة السهلة الطيبة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، ويعتبر من الأسماء ذات المعنى الحسن والدلالة الطيبة، حيث يوحي باللين والسهولة واللطف في التعامل، مما يجعله من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: لیناحتون
